title: Structure-Aware Multimodal Retrieval Under Data Scarcity, Privacy Constraints and Out-of-Domain Content
abstract: arXiv:2611.33649v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Purpose: Figure retrieval from reference atlases in expert domains like forensic pathology, dentistry and geology must work without labels or training pairs, on content that often cannot leave local hardware, and on images outside the training data of image-text encoders. This work proposes a structure-aware pipeline that satisfies all three, retrieving figures through the page structure recovered by layout geometry and a local open-weight 8B VLM. Methods: A geometry-based pairing method is introduced, in which the model receives a schematic of the detected boxes and selects each picture's caption without access to pixels or text. Caption retrieval is evaluated on three private corpora (29 books, 10,421 figures, 218 queries) with blind human grading, against a lexical baseline, generated descriptions and five image-text encoders. Results: Geometric pairing was correct for 96%, 92% and 77% of pictures in the three domains, against 76%, 45

translated_title: 数据稀缺、隐私约束与域外内容下的结构感知多模态检索
translated_abstract: 目的：在法医病理学、牙科和地质学等专家领域，从参考图谱中检索图表必须在不依赖标签或训练配对的情况下进行，且内容通常不能离开本地硬件，同时图像往往超出图文编码器的训练数据范围。本工作提出了一种结构感知的流程，同时满足这三个条件，通过布局几何恢复的页面结构以及本地开源权重的8B视觉语言模型来检索图表。方法：引入了一种基于几何的配对方法，模型接收检测框的示意图，并在无法访问像素或文本的情况下为每张图片选择对应的标题。标题检索在三个私有语料库（29本书籍、10,421张图表、218个查询）上进行评估，采用盲测人工评分，并与词汇基线、生成描述以及五个图文编码器进行对比。结果：几何配对方法在三个领域中对图片的判断正确率分别为96%、92%和77%，而对比方法仅为76%、45%……（摘要截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一种结构感知的多模态检索流程，利用布局几何与本地开源8B视觉语言模型，在无标签、隐私受限且域外内容的条件下实现专家领域图谱中的图表检索，几何配对正确率最高达96%。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a structure-aware multimodal retrieval pipeline that combines layout geometry with a local open-weight 8B VLM to retrieve figures from expert-domain atlases under data scarcity, privacy constraints and out-of-domain content, achieving up to 96% geometric caption-pairing accuracy.
